replication.target_description: Hypothesis to replicate and bet on: Conservatives become more proenvironmental when appeals to address climate change are framed as past-focused comparisons. To evaluate this hypothesis, the authors perform a regression analysis, with focus on the interaction result between political orientation and condition (interaction b = 0.008, SE = 0.004, t(196) = 2.22, p = 0.03); p.14955.
